content.title: National Burrito Day 2026: Where To Score Freebies, Hot Deals
content.text: Whether you load them with steak and rice or keep it simple with beans and cheese, burrito fans have a day dedicated to their favorite meal. A burrito on a plate. Photo Credit: Pixabay - Alfonso Charles 03/31/2026 6:00 a.m. National Burrito Day in 2026 falls on Thursday, April 2. The annual celebration highlights one of the most popular Mexican-inspired dishes in the US.The burrito dates back to the late 1800s, with the word first appearing in a dictionary of Mexican sayings in 1895, according to National Day Calendar. The name means "little donkey" in Spanish and may refer to how the wrapped food resembled the packs carried by the animals.Burritos later made their way to the US in the 1930s and have since become a staple across the country. Here are some national chains offering deals for National Burrito Day:Chipotle's Burrito Vault ReturnsChipotle is celebrating with the return of its Burrito Vault game, giving rewards members a chance to win more than $2 million in prizes. The giveaways include free burritos for a year, buy-one-get-one entrees, and double protein rewards. The game runs from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. from Monday, March 30, through Wednesday, April 1, with players guessing burrito combinations to unlock prizes. On April 2, customers can also get a $0 delivery fee on digital orders placed through the Chipotle app or website with a minimum purchase.Moe's BOGO and SweepstakesMoe's Southwest Grill is offering a buy-one-get-one-free burrito or bowl at participating locations on April 2. The chain is also running a sweepstakes where rewards members can win free burritos for a year during the one-day promotion. Qdoba's Free Entree DealQdoba is giving rewards members a free burrito or bowl when they buy an entree and a drink on National Burrito Day. The offer is available in-store and online for customers signed into a rewards account.Bubbakoo's Two-Day BOGOBubbakoo's Burritos is marking the holiday with a two-day BOGO burrito deal at participating locations. Customers can redeem the offer in-store or online using the code "BURRITODAY." "Burritos are what built Bubbakoo's," said CEO Chris Ives. "National Burrito Day is one of our favorite food holidays because it gives us an excuse to go big for our guests. Whether you're loading yours with hibachi steak and shrimp, crispy buffalo chicken, or stacking it with all your favorite toppings, it's all about creating something different and celebrating the burrito." The emerging Mexican fusion chain started in 2008 in Point Pleasant, New Jersey. It has since grown to more than 140 locations in 15 states, including Connecticut, Delaware, Maryland, New Hampshire, New York, and Pennsylvania.If you want to support smaller restaurants, be sure to look up your local favorites to see what they're offering for National Burrito Day.
